mod formatting;

pub use formatting::{NormalizeOptions, normalize_label, normalize_label_with};

# Label normalizer fixture

Call `normalize_label` for the compatible lowercase behavior. Use
`normalize_label_with` and `NormalizeOptions` to preserve case or add a prefix.
